A '''safehouse''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] storm [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] decided to defect to the Rebel Alliance. The safehouse was located in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and was used to screen the pickup of Madine.
